chunks: And ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj narrated, saying:

I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who marries his female slave to his male slave. Should she continue to serve him as she used to, seeing him uncovered, or him seeing her in that state? So he disliked that and said: My father عليه السلام prevented me from marrying one of my male servants to my female slave for that reason.

key_terms.تَقُومُ عَلَيْهِ: serves him or attends upon him
key_terms.مَمْلُوكَتَهُ: his female slave whom he owns

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about marrying a male slave to a female slave owned by the same master?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a legal concern related to marrying a female slave to a male slave owned by the same master, particularly regarding continued domestic service and exposure between them. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام expresses disapproval of such an arrangement when it leads to improper seeing of one another, and cites the practice of his father عليه السلام as the reason.
